summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Future Soccer Cup (FSC). 24/24 pytest backend tests passed covering health, auth (admin + family), teams/players CRUD with admin RBAC, matches + result entry, standings + top-scorers aggregation, hotels/transports/tours CRUD, bookings flow (create, mine, admin list, status update). Frontend smoke-tested: home, all public pages (fixture, posiciones, equipos, jugadores, reservas), admin login/redirect, admin nav to all sections, family registration, booking modal + mis-reservas, player detail/carnet with QR, logout + protected-route redirect. All critical flows working. No blocker bugs found.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True. Starlette will silently drop Access-Control-Allow-Credentials when origin is '*', so only same-origin (ingress) deployments work. Cross-origin logins from other hosts would fail. Explicit FRONTEND_URL should be in CORS_ORIGINS.
Cascade deletes players but leaves orphaned matches & bookings referencing the deleted team. Match list still renders with blank team names (—). Consider cascading or soft-delete.
Status is received as query param, not body JSON (contradicts REST conventions). Works but unusual.
set_auth_cookies uses secure=False hardcoded. For production over HTTPS this should be driven by env to enable Secure flag.

integration_issues.issue: Promise.all has no .catch(). If ANY endpoint (e.g., /bookings for non-admin race) rejects, all counters stay at 0 silently. Not a blocker since admin is authorized, but resilience is weak.

issues: Public pages trigger /api/auth/me which returns 401 for anonymous visitors, producing harmless console error noise on every page load. Consider skipping /auth/me when no auth cookie present, or swallowing 401 silently.

action_items: Optional: Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to explicit FRONTEND_URL for credential-based cross-origin requests.
Optional: Cascade-delete matches & bookings when a team is deleted (or prevent deletion if references exist).
Optional: In AdminDashboard.jsx, use Promise.allSettled + per-call fallback to avoid silent 0s.
Optional: Suppress 401 console noise from /api/auth/me for anonymous users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 691 lines and near the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth.py, teams.py, matches.py, bookings.py).
CORS allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is a known footgun - browsers will refuse the combination for real cross-origin.
_crud_endpoints closure pattern registers multiple endpoint functions all named _list/_get/_create etc. They work via APIRouter but makes stack-trace identification harder.
login_attempts lockout is per IP+email; good, but never GCs old docs - add TTL index.
Cookies set with secure=False; need env-driven flag for HTTPS production.
